{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers
loyal_completed = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Confirm the number of such orders
num_loyal_completed = len(loyal_completed)

# Compute the mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Print both values for verification
num_loyal_completed, mean_revenue"}
